body.name: Uniformly honest nuclear-ball procedures
body.construction: \[\mathcal H_{\alpha,n}=\left\{(\widehat L_n,R_n):(\widehat L_n,R_n)\text{ is measurable in }(X_n,\Xi_n,\Zeta_n),\ R_n\ge0,\ \inf_{\vartheta_n=(L_n,D_n)\in\Theta_n}\Pr_{\mathbb Q_{\vartheta,n},\Xi_n,\Zeta_n}\!\left(\lVert P_{W_n}(\widehat L_n-L_n)\rVert_*\le R_n\right)\ge1-\alpha\right\}.\]
